0.q: The expression of IcSRO1 was induced by salt, drought, and the plant hormone ABA... exogenous expression of IcSRO1 gene reduced the sensitivity of Arabidopsis to exogenous ABA.

1.q: The transgenic Arabidopsis overexpressing IcSRO1 showed higher tolerance against salt and drought stress along with lower accumulation of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and superoxide (O2−) than the wild type.
